entries.0828ab9049aeac7a: The company and others, including 16 consolidated subsidiaries, provide sales support and talent support services. Consolidated employees numbered 429 as of August 31, 2025 (the average annual headcount of temporary employees was 78). In addition, as of August 2025, the company had outsourcing contracts with approximately 3,500 crowdworkers. Research and development expenses for the fiscal year ended August 2025 were ¥164,648 thousand.

entries.27964f88da0409ae: The Human Resources Support Business provides employment support that connects people who could potentially work, as new workers, with small and medium-sized enterprises struggling with labor shortages. It operates the job site "Mama Works," which specializes in "work-from-home" jobs, and the number of registered members exceeded 650,000 as of August 2025. Job advertisements generate revenue in the form of listing fees according to the listing period, and consulting on building operational workflows that enable work using cloud workers generates revenue according to the contract period. The Company itself has used cloud workers since 2015 and, as of August 2025, had outsourcing contracts with about 3,500 people. Sales results for the fiscal year ended August 2025 were up 24.0% from the previous year. In addition to the Company, Makev Holdings Inc. and Kaimaku Inc. carry out this business.
entries.39be4ff428b53940: The Sales Support Business uses the sales-related database obtained through the Group's business activities and the proprietary sales support system "Sales Crowd" to provide test marketing execution support suited to the products and services of client companies that mainly operate businesses targeting corporate customers. Over roughly 1 year, it verifies sales plans from various angles and finds highly effective patterns, supporting improvements in clients' sales results and productivity. A sales plan consists of a target list and a talk script, and the Company handles all of the preparation. As of the end of August 2025, the cumulative number of companies supported was more than 15,500, and plans are drawn up from the database that accumulates that data. Sales results for the fiscal year ended August 2025 were up 22.7% from the previous year, the largest of the 3 service categories. In addition to the Company, Sales Crowd Inc., Addlast Inc. and Unique Career Inc. carry out this business.

entries.795a38ce9d15bce8: Operating profit for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥3,102,587 thousand (up 25.7% year on year), ordinary profit was ¥3,193,257 thousand (up 29.4%), and net income attributable to owners of the parent was ¥1,954,663 thousand (up 37.1%). Cost of sales was ¥3,999,697 thousand (up 32.5%), mainly reflecting increases in outsourcing expenses and subcontracting expenses. Gross profit was ¥9,269,841 thousand (up 22.0%), and selling, general and administrative expenses were ¥6,167,253 thousand (up 20.2%), with increases in salaries and allowances, advertising expenses and commission fees.

entries.9cbf58e3fcb1a0dd: [[term:annual-securities-report|Annual securities report]] states that the Group consists of the company, 16 consolidated subsidiaries and one equity-method affiliate, and conducts its Work Innovation Business, which aims to make effective use of external resources and improve productivity for its customers, mainly providing sales support for small and medium-sized enterprises. This business consists mainly of two businesses: the Sales Support Business, which provides sales support services, and the Talent Support Business, which provides human resource support services, and is a single segment. Revenue for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥13,269,538 thousand, and year-on-year changes by service were: Sales Support Business up 22.7%, Talent Support Business up 24.0%, and Other up 92.4%. The annual securities report states that the Group's main revenue comes from sales support services.
